name: 030-voice-clone-design-warm
description: Voice design, then cloning. The Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign talker synthesizes a short sample in a voice described by `instructions`; the sample is enrolled as a voice profile on the 0.6B Base talker, which reads a longer paragraph in that voice. Two contrasting descriptions show the description steers the voice. The gates are measured on the audio: STT word error rate, median F0, and ECAPA speaker-encoder cosine.

request_body.input: Good evening. Tonight I will read you a story about the sea, so settle in and listen closely.
request_body.instructions: A warm, mature male narrator with a deep, calm and resonant voice, speaking slowly and clearly.

design_params.instructions: A warm, mature male narrator with a deep, calm and resonant voice, speaking slowly and clearly.

request_body.input: The old lighthouse stood at the edge of the cliff, its white paint worn grey by a century of storms. Every evening the keeper climbed the spiral stairs, trimmed the wick, and watched the beam sweep across the dark water, guiding the fishing boats safely home.

contrast.high: A high-pitched, bright young female voice, cheerful and energetic.
